To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of cartilage grafts in the Asian nose is safe and effective, with minimal complications; 2) cartilage grafts are the preferred grafts for nasal reconstruction in the Asian nose; 3) the use of autologous cartilage grafts is associated with less complications and better aesthetic outcome than allogeneic cartilage grafts; and 4) the use of auricular conchal cartilage is safe and effective in Asian noses.
The most common graft used in rhinoplasty was the septal cartilage followed by the auricular cartilage.
